headless_tests.result: All six rule and playthrough suites printed SUITE_COMPLETE: PASS and exited 0, on the uncommitted bump and again at commit 280bc6e. Dead Run's runner result is 'failed' only because its playthrough writes report JSON files into android-games/dead-run/ (source-drift guard); the files were deleted and are not in the build.

emulator.checks: install, launch (process alive, game screen in foreground, screenshot), Home and resume (same process), force-stop and cold relaunch (process alive, screenshot), no FATAL/ANR in logcat
emulator.signature_change: Installing a debug-signed APK over the release-signed install fails with INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE (signatures do not match); the release line needs one uninstall of the debug builds.
emulator.not_run: The existing save-reading emulator fixtures (android_smoke.py/android_upgrade.py) use run-as, which release (non-debuggable) APKs refuse; gameplay/save/update fixtures were not rerun on the release APKs. Game logic is unchanged from the debug candidates those fixtures verified; only the version code and signing changed.
emulator.obtainium_import: Obtainium 1.7.1 (x86_64) on the emulator imported all seven entries from the obtainium://apps link and matched them to the installed packages by id. Without a token the private repo is not readable, so download/update through Obtainium is unverified.
